# Wanted

> Wanted is an agent-native tour manager for independent musicians. Its agent, Gus, uses Qloo's taste graph to predict which US cities (and which neighborhoods in them) love an act's sound. He puts up a WANTED poster in those cities that fans sign as proof. Once fifty fans sign in a city, he negotiates a date with a venue that fits, inside limits the artist sets, and brings back one decision to approve. Built for the Qloo Agentic Hackathon ("Agents, but with taste").

- Live app (works on a phone): https://trywanted.vercel.app
- Demo act: https://trywanted.vercel.app/a/maya-ortiz
- A fan's view of a poster: https://trywanted.vercel.app/w/maya-ortiz/burlington-vt
- Source (MIT): https://github.com/wafflebytes/wanted
- Full detail for agents: https://trywanted.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## What a judge or agent should know first

- Gus is ambient. Calls to venues advance on the server whether or not a screen is open (`src/server/ambient.ts`). When you arrive, the Dynamic Island already shows a call in progress, an offer waiting on you, and a show already booked.
- Gus remembers how an artist tours (nights they won't play, how far they drive) and keeps to it; every answer is checked so he can't name a venue no lookup returned.
- Every show feeds the next: a tour poster, a booked story and a thank-you story for Instagram, and first dibs on tickets for the fans who signed.
- Qloo decides where and to whom; the LLM only writes and plans. Money and terms are enforced by server policy (`src/server/deals.ts`, `src/server/deal-scope.ts`). Payments are test-mode only, each against an exact reviewed hash.
- Fan data (signatures, neighborhoods, contacts) never goes to Qloo or to any model.
- What's simulated is labeled: venue booking agents are stand-ins, deposits are sandbox/Stripe test, and demo signatures are flagged as demo.

## How Wanted uses Qloo (`src/server/qloo/api.ts`)

- Sound to entities: `/search` and entities by ID or Spotify ID.
- Every US city ranked for the crowd: `/v2/insights` with `filter.type=urn:heatmap`, normalized against a panel of other acts (`src/server/score.ts`).
- Neighborhoods inside a city: `urn:heatmap` scoped to the city.
- Venues ranked for the act's taste, with the reason and open nights: `urn:entity:place` with explainability and hours.
- Poster spots where the crowd hangs out: `urn:entity:place` in the top neighborhoods.
- Who the fans are: `urn:demographics`; cross-domain `podcast`, `tv_show`, `movie`, `brand`; `urn:tag`.
- An opener who shares the crowd: `urn:entity:artist` / `person`, then `/v2/analysis/compare`.
- Without Qloo: every city sheet has a switch that shows what a plain LLM guesses for the same question (`src/server/without-qloo.ts`, `src/server/gus/baseline.ts`).

## Gus as an MCP connector

- Endpoint: `https://trywanted.vercel.app/api/mcp` (remote MCP, streamable HTTP, no sign-in). Add it as a custom connector in Claude or ChatGPT.
- Tools: `where_am_i_wanted`, `city_brief`, `deals`, `ask_gus` (Gus runs his own Qloo lookups and answers), `ask_rooms` (starts a negotiation with a venue; it never pays).
- In Claude the answers come back as cards (an MCP App) you can tap: open a city, then send Gus to ask the venue.
- Money never moves through the connector. A deposit needs the artist's yes in the app, on the exact offer they reviewed (`src/server/mcp.ts`).

## Public JSON API (read-only for the demo act)

- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz`: the act, its sound, opened cities.
- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz/map`: city heat, proof (signatures by city), sleepers.
- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz/city/{metroId}`: neighborhoods, venues, crowd for one city.
- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz/deals`: deals Gus is negotiating, with full letter threads.
- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz/plan`: the tour plan and Gus's suggested changes.
- `GET /api/artist/maya-ortiz/logbook`: everything Gus did, in plain words, and his mandate.
- `GET /api/health`: which providers are live.
